mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates weaker economic growth.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over a 3-month period signals a rapidly weakening labor market, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market anticipates a recession.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and compress equity valuations, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both decline by more than 5% year-over-year, it signals a broad-based weakening of consumer demand that predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Both HOUST and RSAFS decline > 5% y-o-y but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 6% and rising, and the ISM manufacturing index (INDPRO) is below 50 and falling, it signals a rapidly deteriorating economic backdrop that predicts sharply negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 6% and falling, INDPRO < 50 and falling, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is rising by more than 3% year-over-year and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2%, it signals a high-inflation, restrictive monetary policy regime that predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rising > 3% y-o-y and FEDFUNDS > 2%, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) is growing by more than 3% year-over-year and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, it signals a strong demand, tight labor market regime that predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growing > 3% y-o-y and UNRATE < 4%, but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.
